root_cause: Ollama 0.31.1 returned HTTP 400 before generation with 'Failed to initialize samplers: failed to parse grammar' because the complete strict defender-v2 JSON Schema exceeded the provider grammar complexity limit. This is PROVIDER_FAILURE, not model, protocol, reasoning, or lifecycle failure.
provider_change: Ollama now declares JSON_OBJECT capability and receives response_format={"type":"json_object"}; BlueRange retains full unchanged defender-v2 validation and at most one schema-only repair.
audit_fix: Every real provider attempt records an opaque call/run ID, turn, provider/model, request/response timestamps, positive wall-clock latency, HTTP status when available, sanitised error/category, generation state, token usage, output mode, and repair eligibility.

formal_experiment.reason: Mandatory two-run canary gate failed after both single schema-only repairs remained invalid.

defender_quality_metrics.reason: The canary is not a quality estimate and the 24 formal runs were correctly not executed.
